messages:
Ana (partnerships): quick pulse — proposing a recurring SI office-hours cadence for onboarding + cert enablement. want owners and a rough schedule. :calendar:
Mike (solutions): +1. do we want weekly or biweekly? weekly might be heavy for trainers tho.
Julie (enablement): I can host cert Q&A. prefer biweekly 60m slots, one focused on hands-on labs, one on exam prep.
Sandeep (sales-engineering): include a marketplace/hw checklist every other session (marketplace listing ops, AMI/container artifacts, partner SKUs). crucial for SI go-to-market.
Carla (SI-ops): can own recordings and LMS upload. do we have a canonical folder + naming? pls standardize so partners can self-serve.
Tom (product): add short segment 10m on rollout patterns (canary, A/B, fallback) — helps SIs design resilient integrations.
Ana (partnerships): rough proposal below — open to edits:
```text
Tue 16:00 UTC - Onboarding labs (hands-on, 45m)
Thu 17:30 UTC - Certification Q&A + marketplace checklist (60m, biweekly)
Recording + artifacts posted to Partners KB within 48h
```
Mike (solutions): times look good for EMEA/APAC overlap. can we rotate a weekend-friendly slot quarterly for APAC?
Julie (enablement): will prepare 3 graded labs and a short rubric for certs. need a signer for completion badges. who owns badges?
Sandeep (sales-engineering): Partner success should own badge issuance. tagging @carla for ops flow. also include a short runbook for SI to claim marketplace listing.
Carla (SI-ops): I can build the badge workflow into LMS. need sample CSV schema for bulk claims. can someone drop schema?
Ana (partnerships): @Tom can you paste the marketplace checklist link and the model-security checklist here so we can bake it into the agenda?
Tom (product): sure — https://redwood.infra/si-marketplace-checklist and https://redwood.infra/model-security-checklist. we should also cover KMS/HSM integration basics (5m).
CI Bot: deploy status: no blockers for partner-kb site update. build #872 passed :white_check_mark:
Julie (enablement): next steps: I'll draft agenda + labs by EOD Friday. Mike, Sandeep — can you review the rubric early next week?
Mike (solutions): yup. will review Mon.
Sandeep (sales-engineering): will review Mon. also propose we add a short SI intake form to capture customer compliance needs before labs.
Ana (partnerships): perfect. I'll schedule the biweekly slot and add calendar invites after we lock times. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Carla (SI-ops): noted — will prep LMS path and badge workflow once Julie shares content.
Julie (enablement): will include a sample lab access command in the materials:
```bash
# grant ephemeral sandbox access
redwood-sandbox grant --partner "<SI-org>" --ttl 72h --roles dev,lab
```
Tom (product): small ask — include a 1-slide explainer on model pinning & automatic fallback for partners' solution architects.
Ana (partnerships): added to agenda. closing loop: owners = Julie (content/cert), Carla (LMS/badges), Mike + Sandeep (rubric & marketplace ops), Tom (product slides). will follow up with calendar.
Mike (solutions): thanks, looking forward.
Sandeep (sales-engineering): thanks all.
CI Bot: reminder scheduled: si-office-hours-biweekly created for 2026-06-02 16:00 UTC
